name: primitives-effects-image-zoom
title: Image Zoom
description: A rounded photo that slides to a close-up centred on the cursor when you hover, follows the pointer to pan, and toggles the zoom on click.
use: A product or gallery photo should be inspectable up close without opening a lightbox.
avoid: It needs a pointer that can hover; on touch the zoom is a tap and panning fights the page scroll.
a11y: Zoom is hover and click only on a non-focusable div, so keyboard users cannot zoom; the wrapper's img role has no name. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded landscape photograph of snow-tipped peaks above a flat sea of clouds at dusk, filling a rounded card on a black stage. A small caption sits just below it.
behaves: Hovering zooms the photo toward the pointer, and moving the mouse pans the enlarged view to the spot under the cursor; clicking toggles the zoom and leaving returns it to fit.
customise: Pass the image as children, and set zoom scale, transition, width, height and whether hover or click zoom; the pointer-to-origin maths is fixed.
weight: light: One image scaled by a transform; no loop or canvas.
demo: A sunset photo of snowy peaks above a sea of clouds, captioned Hover to zoom, move to pan, click to toggle.
issues: Zoomed frames look slightly soft, since the 2.5x scale stretches the photo.
Nothing signals the hover zoom except the cursor changing shape.
polishWhy: Smooth pointer-anchored zoom on a strong photo; no affordance and no reduced-motion handling.
